ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominant high-intensity (white) background with high-frequency low-intensity (black) linear intersections, approximately 75% white to 25% black distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity vertical column at the median notch; extensive network of narrow, elongated dark geometric streaks distributed across both lobes; concentrated dark pixel clusters at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees relative to the lobe intersection point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to higher amplitude (10-15 pixel depth) jagged peaks at the lateral distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the trailing edges of both lobes from the notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of circular low-intensity pixels at the extreme left distal tip (viewer perspective).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering >80% of the visible high-intensity surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, pervasive linear scarring across the ventral surface; irregular, possibly traumatic jaggedness on the distal tip margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of intersecting linear markings creating a complex grid-like pattern on the inner lobes.
